As an attacker, I count first: 1,000 fake identities lock 150 units each for 20 epochs, 150,000 frozen, capital I cannot roll.

Each honest epoch unlocks 5%; the lock thaws only for real work. A glacier of frozen capital crawls. Miss a check or get caught: the timer resets, 60% slashed.

My ledger: 30% caught, 27,000 slashed, 10 more epochs locked. The violet test: the scam must pay before the lock. A beacon check I cannot predict ends it early.
